summary: Dive into the world of Human Resource KPIs and Metrics with our expert-led training course. Gain valuable insights and boost your professional growth.
lede: Human resource KPIs and metrics help HR practitioners turn workforce data into evidence for operational and strategic decisions. Designed for practitioners with a foundation in HR operations, this course covers selecting and interpreting indicators across recruitment, retention, compensation, learning and productivity. Participants practice building dashboards, assessing workforce costs and retention risks, and presenting findings to support planning and executive decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate to advanced program is designed for practitioners who have a foundational understanding of HR operations and seek to elevate their analytical capabilities to a strategic level.
outcomes: Data Privacy Compliance in People Analytics
modules: Foundations of HR Analytics and ISO 30414
Compensation, Benefits, and Total Rewards Metrics
Workforce Cost and Financial Impact Analysis
Predictive Analytics and AI in HR
HR Dashboard Design and Data Visualization
Strategic HR Reporting and Executive Buy-in
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in human resources or a related management function. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets) is essential. Prior experience with HR Information Systems (HRIS) or ERP platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Oracle HCM is recommended but not required.
